name: io.github.krzysztofsurdy/snipaya-mcp
title: Snipaya
description: Annotate screenshots in the Snipaya macOS app: arrows, text, redaction, crop, export

environmentVariables.name: SNIPAYA_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Token from Snipaya > Settings > AI Assistants. Read from Snipaya when unset

environmentVariables.name: SNIPAYA_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: MCP URL from Snipaya > Settings > AI Assistants. Uses the port Snipaya saved when unset

environmentVariables.name: SNIPAYA_MCP_NO_LAUNCH
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to never open Snipaya when it is not running
